landing.title: Landing zones & governance
landing.text: Multi-account AWS foundations with Control Tower, Organizations and SCPs, IAM Identity Center federated with Microsoft Entra ID or Google Workspace, guardrails as code in Terraform or CDK.

security.title: Information security & compliance
security.text: Network perimeters with Transit Gateway, Network Firewall, CloudFront, WAF and Shield Advanced; Security Hub remediation; KMS and Secrets Manager; immutable S3 Object Lock archives; email authentication; incident response.

platforms.title: Platforms & resilience
platforms.text: Production EKS and ECS platforms with GitOps and Karpenter, Aurora and Valkey data tiers, multi-region disaster recovery designed as code and validated in live failover drills.

ai.title: AI systems
ai.text: Governed agentic platforms on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: RAG with cited sources, agents that review merge requests and recommend while people change production, credential-less OIDC delivery.

leadership.title: Leadership & enablement

gaming.title: AWS platform engineering, edge migration & disaster recovery
gaming.client: Global mobile & web gaming publisher · via a consulting partner
gaming.text: Owns the Terraform platform behind three live titles (six EKS and eleven Aurora clusters). Moved seven production zones from Cloudflare to CloudFront, Route 53, ACM, WAFv2 and Shield Advanced on budget, including Origin Shield tuning with estimated savings of about USD 6.4k a month. One Terraform-managed DR platform for EKS, Aurora, Valkey and CI hosts, validated in a live failover drill; multi-region AWS Backup with vault lock; Amazon MQ upgrades; a 12-exercise CloudFront/WAF workshop for 12 engineers.

iot.title: AI-native internal developer platform
iot.client: Global semiconductor & IoT technology company · via a UK staffing partner
iot.text: Principal architecture and hands-on delivery of a production generative-AI developer platform on Amazon Bedrock AgentCore: multi-agent orchestration, serverless APIs and event-driven services. DEV/TEST/PROD delivery with Python CDK and GitLab OIDC across eleven AWS accounts; Cognito and Entra ID federation; least-privilege IAM and security remediation; governance across 23 repositories and 7 generated applications; SVN-to-GitLab modernisation.

fintech.title: Cloud platform, compliance archive & security operations
fintech.text: Control Tower landing zone with Security Hub and Google Workspace SSO into IAM Identity Center; GitLab OIDC CI/CD; ECS microservices streaming real-time market data; AppSync GraphQL; Managed Grafana. Immutable 7-year email archive on S3 Object Lock (218k messages from 97 dormant identities) that cut licensing about 51%. Led the response to a P1 brand-impersonation attack, hardened SPF/DKIM/DMARC on ten domains, migrated Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace.

reevo.title: Landing zone & multi-tenant Kubernetes
reevo.client: Gas infrastructure operator (critical infrastructure) · via ReeVo Cloud & Cyber Security
reevo.text: Control Tower, Security Hub and IAM Identity Center federated with Entra ID; hub-and-spoke Transit Gateway with Direct Connect and VPN failover; Network Firewall with Suricata; multi-tenant EKS with ArgoCD GitOps and Karpenter; private NLB to API Gateway to CloudFront delivery with WAF, Cognito and KMS.

institution.title: Enterprise landing zones & data protection
institution.client: European institution (via PwC Luxembourg) · Volkswagen Digital Solutions
institution.text: Institution-wide backup strategy on AWS Backup aligned to the AWS Data Protection Reference Architecture; automated firewall threat lists; remediation of exposed resources from Security Hub and Config findings; secure accounts inside the MAN-compliant Group landing zone with Step Functions provisioning.

founder.name: Raffaele Sollecito
founder.role: Founder & Managing Director · Principal Cloud Solutions Architect
founder.bio: Raffaele leads every Kumokage engagement as the accountable architect. He has more than ten years in software engineering, seven of them on AWS: as an independent principal architect, a cloud architect for a European institution through PwC Luxembourg, a cloud solutions architect at Volkswagen Digital Solutions, a solutions architect at ITnet and an AWS DevOps engineer at Tantosvago.
